arguments.argument: The defence did not request an adjournment.
arguments.quote: Ms. Brask told the court that she had received the 900-page case file only three days before this hearing and asked for an adjournment of two weeks to prepare the defence.

arguments.argument: The time and facilities were adequate for the proceedings.
arguments.quote: Reading the judgment took about forty minutes.

arguments.argument: The record does not show the full proceedings, including the defence's preparation.
arguments.quote: Defence counsel Lena Brask was present; Ms. Brask's objection was recorded; the defence announced an appeal.
